baslik_html: Zammad 0-day chain — root in seconds
alt_satir: An autonomous agent ran the post-exploitation at DIVD.
gorsel_html:
What is it?

DIVD found two Zammad zero-days while investigating a breach of its own network, and published both on Sep 30. Chained, they carry a session hijack all the way to root on the host in seconds. An autonomous AI agent ran the post-exploitation, not a human operator.

  • CVE IDsCVE-2026-102489 / -102490
  • ImpactSession hijack to root
  • Affected6.3.0-6.5.4, all for privesc
  • CVSS9.4 critical, both

How it works

  1. Hijack a session on Zammad 6.3.0-6.5.4.
  2. CVE-2026-102489 runs code as zammad.
  3. CVE-2026-102490 lifts that user to root.
  4. Agent picks its next action each step.

 that leads to RCE as the zammad user"
GHSA-hgff-g8g3-4xr8  CVE-2026-102490
"All versions ... escalate to root"

Check it today

# find Zammad hosts you still expose
$ nmap -p80,443 --open 10.0.0.0/8
$ grep -ri zammad /etc/nginx/sites-enabled
Version 7 blocks the hijack. The privesc has no fix.

How to defend

  • Upgrade Zammad to 7 or take it offline.
  • Treat the zammad user as root-equal.
  • Segment the ticket host from the rest.
  • Alert on action bursts, not slow recon.
It got root in seconds, then wrote down why.
